description: Safe household actions, offline memory, and evidence-backed answers on top of the full Home Assistant control surface.

tools.name: calendars_list
tools.description: List calendar entities that this token can access, so an agent can select a calendar before retrieving or changing its events.

tools.name: calendars_list-events
tools.description: Retrieve events from one calendar entity during the required start and end time window; use this to inspect scheduling conflicts or upcoming commitments. Required: calendarId, start, end.

tools.name: components_list
tools.description: List integrations currently loaded by this Home Assistant instance to diagnose availability and choose supported capabilities.

tools.name: config_get-system-info
tools.description: Get Home Assistant configuration and version. Returns the Json.

tools.name: config_validate
tools.description: Ask Home Assistant to validate its configuration before a reload or restart, returning server-side syntax and setup errors.

tools.name: error-log_get
tools.description: Retrieve the current Home Assistant error log for diagnosing failing integrations, automations, and service calls.

tools.name: events_fire
tools.description: Fire the required named Home Assistant event with an optional JSON body, for testing automations or notifying event listeners. Required: eventType.

tools.name: events_list
tools.description: List the event types currently exposed by Home Assistant before subscribing to or firing an event.

tools.name: history_list
tools.description: Get entity history for a time window. Required: timestamp. Optional: filter_entity_id, end_time.

tools.name: intent_handle
tools.description: Send a natural-language request to Home Assistant Assist and return the resolved intent response for the configured conversation agent.

tools.name: logbook_list
tools.description: Get a logbook time window. Required: timestamp. Optional: entity, end_time.

tools.name: services_call
tools.description: Call a Home Assistant service. Required: domain, service.

tools.name: services_list
tools.description: List callable Home Assistant service domains and actions so an agent can validate a service before issuing a mutation.

tools.name: states_delete
tools.description: Remove a custom entity state. Required: entityId. Destructive.

tools.name: states_get
tools.description: Retrieve one live entity state and attributes by the required entity ID, suitable for checking a device before taking action. Required: entityId.

tools.name: states_list
tools.description: List all current entity states and attributes for inventory, filtering, and state-based household analysis.

tools.name: states_set
tools.description: Set a state for a custom entity. Required: entityId.

tools.name: template_render
tools.description: Render a Home Assistant Jinja template against the live state machine to safely inspect a computed value before automation use.
